mutation: one value in one rotating dataset/message, cumulative; GRIB encoded lengths preserved; measure actual 1 MiB block identity
primary_metric: unchanged n8_matrix complete client query clocks; all versions retain distinct provenance and output
timing_boundary: native owned arrays in worker; IoTDB includes IPC and client owned copy; no claim of identical transport
arm_order: four cyclic campaigns; each arm occupies each position once per scenario/V block
cache_claim: prepared OS pages; new owner/worker per campaign; retain first request separately; no cold-disk claim
scope: purposefully favorable workload; best observed result within this configuration, not a universal or theoretical upper bound; no production changes
